headline: Chancellor says ‘It is my job to protect resilience of the UK economy and the budget will do that’ in the face of international headwinds
summary_en: Chancellor John Healey at IMF Bangkok meetings discussed UK and international cooperation to respond to global headwinds and strengthen growth.
summary_zh: 财政大臣希利在IMF曼谷会议谈国际合作应对全球逆风、强化增长。
watch_en: UK and international partners work together to respond to global economic headwinds and strengthen the conditions for growth.
watch_zh: 英国与国际伙伴合作应对全球经济逆风并强化增长条件。
excerpt: Chancellor of the Exchequer, John Healey used the IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok to set out how the UK and its international partners can work together to respond to global economic headwinds and strengthen the conditions for growth.
